full_outcome_description: Effectively use variables, conditionals and loops in computer programs
Design, construct and test simple programs that include user-defined functions and data structures
Write programs efficiently by discovering and leveraging libraries
Implement good programming practices including unit testing, basic documentation and readability.
Reflect on prior programming knowledge and articulate goals for learning in this unit.
Develop a personal study plan and justify how it aligns with your target grade and unit structure, including engagement with feedback, submission timelines, and assessment requirements.
Document the process of setting up the programming environment and building programs, including evidence of challenges, actions, and outcomes.
Summarise key compilation concepts and terminal commands used when building and running programs in different languages.
Reflect on your learning process and describe strategies you will use to improve your confidence using the terminal.
Develop simple programs using sequence, variables, and method calls, and explain how they work.
Reflect on what you have learned and evaluate personal challenges and strategies for programming success.
Apply control flow concepts (conditions and loops) to write correct and understandable programs.
